purpose: extend the qualified one-sided positive-transfer ceiling to an explicit upstream-refit sensitivity ensemble without treating refits as IID probability samples

validation_inference.method: one-sided replicate-studentized cluster bootstrap-t within each supplied refit
validation_inference.familywise_family: all independent group by adjacent information-step cells within one refit
validation_inference.confidence_interpretation: conditional on the fitted refit and declared validation sampling design

upstream_refit_rule.aggregation: all supplied refits must be robust_generalizing for a step to pass
upstream_refit_rule.refit_weighting: no averaging for the confirmatory consensus decision

fail_closed.insufficient_refits: consensus steps unavailable and ceiling remains at base level

qualification_inheritance.reason: across-refit operation is deterministic sensitivity intersection, not a stochastic refit-population interval
